Trump's Stance on Ukraine War Raises European Concerns

European observers are questioning President Donald Trump's evolving stance on the war in Ukraine, suggesting that his shifts in position may erode trust among allies and adversaries alike. The situation has led to calls for Europe to take a more independent leadership role in resolving the conflict, particularly as Russia's position in the war is seen as having been precarious before Trump's recent statements.
